# FEOD

> FEOD (Fractal Entity Oriented Design) is a frontend architecture methodology for organizing applications around modules, public API, fractal structure, and controlled dependencies.

## Summary

FEOD helps frontend teams keep project structure readable and verifiable as codebases grow. It defines top-level levels, module boundaries, allowed imports, and public API rules. The documentation is available in Russian and English; the Russian root is the default locale, and English pages live under `/en/`.

## Start Here

- [Overview](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/get-started/overview): English introduction to FEOD, its purpose, levels, and differences from regular modular architecture and FSD.
- [Обзор](https://fractal-oriented.tech/get-started/overview): Русское введение в FEOD, уровни, модули, public API и контролируемые зависимости.
- [Quick Start](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/get-started/quick-start): Minimal project frame and first import rules.
- [Быстрый старт](https://fractal-oriented.tech/get-started/quick-start): Минимальный FEOD-каркас для нового frontend-проекта.
- [FEOD in 5 Minutes](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/get-started/feod-in-5-minutes): Short learning path for the core idea.
- [FEOD за 5 минут](https://fractal-oriented.tech/get-started/feod-in-5-minutes): Короткий путь к базовой модели FEOD.

## Core Concepts

- [Modularity](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/core-concepts/modularity): Modules as responsibility boundaries.
- [Fractality](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/core-concepts/fractality): Repeating structural principles at different scales.
- [Entity Orientation](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/core-concepts/entity-orientation): Files and directories as FEOD entities with roles.
- [Levels](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/core-concepts/levels): `app`, `pages`, `modules`, `common`, and `global`.
- [Public API](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/core-concepts/public-api): Supported contracts for using FEOD entities.
- [Dependency Rules](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/core-concepts/dependency-rules): Controlled dependency direction and boundary rules.

## Reference

- [Import Matrix](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/reference/import-matrix): Allowed imports between FEOD levels.
- [Module Contract](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/reference/module-contract): What a module must expose and protect.
- [Public API Rules](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/reference/public-api): Rules for `index.ts` and external consumption.
- [Naming Rules](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/reference/naming): Canonical level, module, and public API naming.
- [Code Smells](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/reference/code-smells): Common signs of boundary violations.
- [Glossary](https://fractal-oriented.tech/en/reference/glossary): Canonical FEOD terms.
